entities.name: Chicken TP53 (P10360)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Gallus gallus TP53 (UniProt P10360).
p53 tumor-suppressor transcription factor; DNA binding regulates cell-cycle arrest, DNA repair, and apoptosis.
Pfam detects P53 DNA-binding domain at residues 85–274 and P53 tetramerization domain at 300–335.
Sequence length 367 aa; calculated mass 40.17 kDa; theoretical pI 8.21; GRAVY −0.555; instability index 73.99.
